title: psorospermum axillare
intro: Psorospermum axillare, commonly known as the "Madagascar King of Spades," is a plant species in the Hypericaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Psorospermum axillare include its analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antipyretic effects, which make it useful in the treatment of pain, inflammation, and fever. The bioactive constituents of Psorospermum axillare include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
